messages.subject: Assistance needed
parts:
Hi all,

I have spent the past 4 hours looking at every Stackoverflow etc. link that addresses summarizing multiple columns but can not seem to find the correct syntax to do what I need to achieve.
looked at multiple column examples using ply, reshape2 etc. but seems I have not gotten it correct.

One version simply "Summed" the Easting and Northing and grouped by Date_time which was "close" but could not get it to provide mean of values.

Seems simple so I must be missing a key to the correct syntax.

My df has 135,532 rows and 3 columns

Col A=Date_time value, B= Easting, C= Northing.

 

Data are GPS coordinates from flight data with multiple locations for each minute.  Originally times also included HH:MM:SS but I just need a mean value for each minute for each date.

I need to summarize by Date_time with only a mean value for each of the B & C columns.

Data Example

Date_time          Easting  Northing

2/06/15 19:18     712697  3721846

2/06/15 19:18     712700  3721848

2/06/15 19:18     712701  3721848

2/06/15 19:18     712702  3721848

 

What can I use?  Reshape2, plyr, dply? so the multiple column means are summarized by the Date times similar to this?

Date            time       Northing     Easting

2/8/2015    19:56    3710109    704933

2/8/2015    20:33    3710118    704503

2/6/2015    18:26    3710107    704383

2/6/2015    18:27    3710111    704737



Tnx,

Bruce

parts:
Have you tried summarize_each() in dplyr?

> library(dplyr)
> df <- data_frame(
+     Date_time=c("2/06/15 19:18","2/06/15 19:18","2/06/15 19:18","2/06/15 19:18"), 
+     Easting = c(712697,712700,712701,712702), 
+     Northing = c(3721846,3721848,3721848,3721848))
> 
> df %>% group_by(Data_time) %>% summarize_each(funs(mean))
Error: unknown column 'Data_time'
> df %>% group_by(Date_time) %>% summarize_each(funs(mean))
